# <span id="aanchor131"></span> Meter/Location Rollups

The Rollup Viewer shows accumulated hourly, daily, monthly, batch and period totals for meters and locations as calculated by the Rollup Services. Accumulated or averaged totals for relevant fields for meters and locations are stored in the Final Form Tables.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Rollup Viewer:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Rollup Viewers**.
2.  Click **Meter/Location Rollups**.

To view rolled data, select a list, location, or meter. Configure parameters (Resolution, Date Range, Meter or Location, etc.), and then click the **Refresh** button to update the data in the tabs.

Changing any parameter will refresh or clear the data, depending on the data resolution.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Rollup Viewer Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

Use the By Meter or By Location radio buttons to view individual members of the selected item. Navigate through the members using the forward <br/>![](data:image/png;base64,) or back <br/>![](data:image/png;base64,) buttons. The <br/>![](data:image/png;base64,) button can be used to select the last member of a list or location or close group while the <br/>![](data:image/png;base64,) button can be used to navigate back to the first member. The <br/>![](data:image/png;base64,) button will open the tree view, which allows you to move throughout a location or list hierarchy directly to select specific members.

#### Data Options

- **Revision**
  - **Current** - Displays the most current data, including any edits that have been made.
  - **Original Data** - This is the data that came in during import. This data has not had any edits (only available for gas meters).
- **Quantity**
  - **Gas Volume** - Displays data by volume for gas meters.
  - **Liquid Volume** - Displays data by volume for liquid meters.
  - **Mass** - Displays data by mass.
- **Closed**
  - **Adjusted** - Displays the original closed total plus any PPAs.
  - **Closed** - This is the final total from the closed data.
- **Conditions**
  - **Measured** - Volume and energy calculated at the meter's pressure base.
  - **System** - Volume and energy calculated at the system pressure base.

#### Function Buttons

- **Show** - Displays the time frame where data exists in the appropriate final form table for the selected meter or location. This is useful to help determine where in time there is data to display.

- **Open** - Available only when a meter is selected. It opens the Meter Editor in view only mode for the selected meter. Subsequently clicking on the Open Data button in the Meter Editor brings up the Volume Editor on the same selected meter.

- **Unrolled Data** - Launches the Service Queues screen to display data waiting to be queued in the [Unrolled Meters tab](../../Settings%20Manager/Services/Unrolled%20Meters%20Tab.md) or the [Unrolled Locations tab](../../Settings%20Manager/Services/Unrolled%20Locations%20Tab.md).

- **Refresh** - The Refresh button updates the data in the tabs at the bottom of the Rollups Viewer for the parameters specified. Changing any parameter (Resolution, Date Range, Meter or Location, etc.) will cause the tabs to be cleared.

- **Print** - Available when Resolution is set to Hourly or Daily. It will print the GVS Hourly or Daily report for the selected meter or location.

  If multiple months are selected, the report can be very long, especially if the resolution is set to Hourly. The maximum number of rows to display has no effect on the reports.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 597;height: 127;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Filter Settings">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Filter Settings</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Filter Settings">

If the [Remember UI Filter Values](../../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md) option is enabled, the Rollup Viewer remembers the filter and date settings for the duration of the FLOWCAL session. The filter and date settings set in the last Rollup Viewer to be closed are retained when multiple Rollup Viewers are opened. The filter settings are forgotten once a user logs out or closes FLOWCAL. The following filter settings are remembered during a session:

- Object Selector (Meter, Location, or List)
- Date Range Type and Selection
- Data Resolution, Options, By Location, By Meter, Revision, Quantity, Closed, Conditions, Allowables, and Inventory
- FLOWCAL Explorer (pinned or unpinned)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Multiple Products">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Liquid Meters and Locations with Multiple Products</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Multiple Products">

A liquid meter or location may have multiple products flowing on it within the selected time frame. To see the total of all products on each record, set Product to Total Fluid. If the user clicks the Product drop-down, the user can see all of the products that flowed on the selected meter or location for the time frame. To see the flow for a given Product, select that product and then click Refresh. If for a given time frame the selected product only flowed for part of the time, the values displayed will be for the time the selected product was flowing.

</div>

### Right-Click Menu Options

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Add Note">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Add Note</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Add Note">

Notes can be added to any record in the Rollup Viewer. Notes are datetime effective and can be made public or private. When this option is selected a new window will appear to add a note. Notes created here are visible in other places that notes are visible, such as the Volume Editor.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 495;height: 359;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Plot Data">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Plot Data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Plot Data">

This will bring up a graph of the data on the screen. Once on screen, the user has various options available from the menu bar such as: exporting data to a file, choosing how to display the data, picking what data is displayed on the graph, and specifying how to scale the data. On the Rollup Viewer, the user can change meters and the graph will update to show the data.

Since values for Mass are generally much larger numbers than values for Volume or other flow variables, the graph plot displayed within the Meter/Location Rollup Viewer becomes unusable as only the Mass trace line is visible with the other trace lines all being "squeezed" together at the bottom of the plot. To prevent this from happening, the trace line for Mass is now defaulted to not be visible in the graph plot.

Plot Data for Gas Meters

Plot Data for Liquid Meters

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Customize Columns">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Customize Columns and Layout</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Customize Columns">

Use the Customize Column option to specify which columns are visible in the rollup viewer and the order in which they appear. This is configurable on a per user basis, by meter type (e.g., orifice, turbine) and location type (e.g., segment, liquid cavern). When the option is selected, a new window will appear called Available Column List. If visible columns have been removed, they will be listed here. To remove a column, click the column header and drag it onto the Available Column List window.

To restore a column, click the column name in the Available Column List window and drag it back to the rollup viewer grid and drop it between any two columns. You can also move columns around by clicking on a column header and dragging it between two other columns to change the column order. Close the Available Column List window to save the configuration settings. You can do this for each rollup viewer tab, but you must save the column layout before moving to another tab or the changes will be lost.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 483;height: 189;" />

Click **Save Column Layout** in the right-click menu to save the column order. Click **Reset Column Layout** to revert the changes to the default settings.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Admin Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Admin Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Admin Options">

The following options are available to users with admin privileges:

- **Save As Default for All Users** - Save the current rollup viewer configuration as the default for all users. This is for each tab, each meter and location type.
- **Reset Default for All Users** - Reset the rollup viewer back to the default settings for all users. This is for each tab, each meter and location type.

</div>
